title: Noise sensitivity of parity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $0\leq\delta\leq1$. Define the parity function by $f(x)=\prod_{i\in S}x_i$. If each coordinate of a uniformly chosen input is independently flipped with probability $\delta$, then the probability that the parity changes is $\frac{1-(1-2\delta)^{|S|}}{2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the coordinate indices
